A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LotteryCodec work. Their complete main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–F are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original compression experiments on Kodak and CLIC2020, hypothesis-verification experiments, component ablations, and coding-time measurements in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments, including benchmark results, ablations, and latency measurements, with revisions to some reported CLIC2020 results.

M1.justification: The SuperMask network, Fourier initialization, rewind modulation, training objective, entropy-coding procedure, and encoding/decoding pseudocode are unchanged. Revised mask-search ranges concern evaluation configurations rather than a new method component.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same image-compression coverage: Kodak, CLIC2020, the first-ten-Kodak hypothesis experiments, and the retained resolution-dependent tests. No dataset, task, or distinct test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is retained in the corresponding benchmark and ablation comparisons, including VTM-19.1, HEVC, C3 and its adaptive variant, COOL-CHIC v2, and the autoencoder codecs. Revised baseline scores and plotted positions do not introduce different comparison methods.

E3.justification: Appendix B.5 changes the reported CLIC2020 mask search from [0.15, 0.4] to an optimal-result search over [0.15, 0.9], distinguishing other Figure 7 points trained over [0.15, 0.45]. Table 2 also expands the fast configuration from 0.15–0.30 to 0.15–0.40, retaining 0.05 increments. These are reported setting revisions; the PDFs do not establish which experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The architecture and mask-ratio analyses, component ablations, alternative initialization/modulation/masking tests, latency studies, and Appendix F visualizations are retained. Changes to comparator values in existing complexity plots do not add a new diagnostic analysis.

E5.justification: Averaging descriptions and initialization-seed information are unchanged. There are no additions or revisions to repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error-bar reporting, or significance procedures.

E6.justification: Section 4.2 changes the reported CLIC2020 reduction versus VTM-19.1 from -8.91% to up to -9.79%. Reported comparisons change from -6.21% to -5.69% for C3, -3.21% to -2.90% for C3-adapt, and -25.55% to -25.57% for COOL-CHIC v2; the MLIC gap changes from +3.21% to +2.33%. Existing CLIC2020 plots also revise baseline results. The changed search settings prevent treating the headline difference as a demonstrated same-setting gain.

T1.justification: The lottery codec hypothesis, mathematical definitions, rate and loss equations, initialization and gradient derivations, and Appendix C's heuristic SLTH argument are unchanged. No proof or formal assumption is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about the lottery codec hypothesis, rewind modulation, state-of-the-art overfitted compression, and adaptable decoding complexity. Updated numerical comparisons do not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and substantive limitations remain unchanged, including uncertain over-parameterization requirements, high encoding cost, and the distinction between theoretical sparse complexity and practical runtime. Appendix B.5 revises search settings while retaining its computational-budget caveat.

D1.justification: Appendix A.1 adds a pointer to an optimized C++ entropy-coding implementation on the COOL-CHIC project page. Appendix B.5 expands the description of shared resources to identify baseline implementations, datapoints, lambda values, and complexity information. These are documentation and access-guidance changes; external availability was not verified.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussion, and positioning relative to prior codecs and lottery-ticket research are retained. Reference entries move across page boundaries without substantive bibliographic additions or removals.

P1.justification: There are localized wording edits, additional Appendix B.5 cross-references, an expanded search-setting explanation, and a new implementation footnote. The section order and overall narrative structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Existing CLIC2020 plots in Figures 1/10b, 7b, and 11b are redrawn with revised points, curves, or annotation positions. The footnote and expanded prose cause small layout shifts. No figure or table is added or removed, and the overall visual design is retained.

improvement.justification: Appendix B.5 more clearly distinguishes the widest search behind the best reported result from narrower searches used for other plotted points, and Appendix A.1 adds useful implementation guidance. These provide modest gains in interpretability and reproducibility. The method and evidence coverage remain stable, and the stronger headline result does not establish a controlled performance improvement.
